_meta.note: Two deliverables the MCP core opened up (planning/mcp-server-scope.md). (H) scope step 4 — an OPTIONAL streamable-HTTP transport for `hb mcp-serve` (a minimal, stdlib-only http.server POST/JSON-RPC endpoint; stdio stays the default) so remote/hosted MCP clients can reach it. (B) surface B — the Codex/Claude plugin REGISTERS the MCP server, so install = wired (no manual `codex mcp add`). Decisive live investigation (codex 0.147, this machine): Codex reads the SAME `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` format HeartBeat already ships, and `codex plugin list --available` already discovers our `heartbeat` plugin; adding `plugin/.mcp.json` ({mcpServers:{heartbeat:{command:hb,args:[mcp-serve]}}}) makes `codex plugin add` + `codex mcp list` surface the heartbeat stdio server — proven OFFLINE, KEYLESS, in an isolated CODEX_HOME (so the suite never touches the user's ~/.codex). One plugin, both hosts; the MCP server is Python-delivered (needs pip `hb`). Both proofs are deterministic and Docker-free; the codex-live tier is conditional on `command -v codex` (skips cleanly where codex is absent, like python3-gated groups).

tasks.title: Author the HTTP-transport proof spec
tasks.description: Spec-first: write docs/howto/gate-examples/mcp-http.sh — spin `hb mcp-serve --http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0` as a subprocess, read the bound port from its stderr readiness line (blocking on that line eliminates the bind race), then POST JSON-RPC over HTTP with urllib (stdlib): (1) initialize returns a valid handshake; (2) tools/list carries the tools; (3) tools/call state matches `hb state` — POP `last_updated` before comparing (state.project stamps now_iso per projection, so the two projections differ only there — mirror nostamp() in mcp-server.sh); (4) an act tool (gate on a passing project) over HTTP records gate_passed in events.jsonl and advances. Print MCP-HTTP-OK. Deterministic, localhost-only (no external network), no model, no Docker.

tasks.title: Implement the HTTP transport
tasks.description: Add serve_http(hbdir, host, port) to py/src/heartbeat/mcp_server.py using stdlib http.server (ThreadingHTTPServer + BaseHTTPRequestHandler): POST reads the JSON-RPC body, dispatches through the SAME _handle used by stdio, and writes the response as application/json; a notification (no id) returns 202 with no body; malformed JSON returns a JSON-RPC parse error. Bind, then print the actual host:port to stderr as the readiness signal (supports --port 0). Must stay stdlib-only (the mc1c4 invariant).

tasks.title: Wire `mcp-serve --http/--host/--port`
tasks.description: Extend the cli.py `mcp-serve` subparser with --http (flag), --host (default 127.0.0.1), --port (int, default 0); dispatch to mcp_server.serve_http when --http else serve (stdio stays the default). The new work is the DISPATCH BRANCH — a parsed flag that isn't wired to serve_http would leave stdio running, which the HTTP proof (ht1c1) catches by actually round-tripping over HTTP. No node changes.

phases.title: Plugin registers the MCP server (surface B, both hosts)

tasks.title: Author the plugin-registration proof spec
tasks.description: Spec-first: write docs/howto/gate-examples/plugin-mcp.sh with two tiers. STATIC (always): plugin/.mcp.json is valid JSON and declares an mcpServers.heartbeat whose command is `hb` and args include `mcp-serve`; .claude-plugin/marketplace.json lists the `heartbeat` plugin (source ./plugin). CODEX-LIVE (only if `command -v codex`, in an isolated CODEX_HOME=mktemp so the user's ~/.codex is never touched, offline): `codex plugin marketplace add <repo> --json`, `codex plugin add heartbeat@heartbeat-marketplace --json`, then `codex mcp list --json` shows a `heartbeat` stdio server with command `hb` and args `[mcp-serve]`. Parse the `--json` STDOUT for that assertion (2>/dev/null) — codex prints a harmless 'Refusing to create helper binaries under temporary dir' WARNING to stderr when CODEX_HOME is a tempdir; tolerate it. Print PLUGIN-MCP-OK (noting whether the codex-live tier ran or was skipped).

tasks.title: Add plugin/.mcp.json (register hb mcp-serve)
tasks.description: Add plugin/.mcp.json = {"mcpServers":{"heartbeat":{"command":"hb","args":["mcp-serve"]}}} so installing the HeartBeat plugin in Codex OR Claude Code registers the MCP server (it defaults --dir to the workspace ./.hb). Additive only — do not renumber/bump versions or change existing plugin manifests. Confirm the node suite's bootstrap/plugin tests stay green.
